mapper.select: SELECT T.RNUM, T.* FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER(order by head_budget_date desc) RNUM, h.*, NVL((SELECT SUM(head_budget) FROM head_budget h2 WHERE h2.head_budget_year = h.head_budget_year AND h2.head_budget_ty = 2), 0) as useTotal, ((select sum(head_budget) from head_budget h2 WHERE h2.head_budget_year = h.head_budget_year and head_budget_ty=1) -nvl((select sum(head_budget) from head_budget h2 WHERE h2.head_budget_year = h.head_budget_year and head_budget_ty=2 ),0)) as restBG FROM HEAD_BUDGET H WHERE 1 = 1 and head_budget_ty=1 and head_budget_code=1 ) T WHERE T.RNUM BETWEEN (#{currentPage} * 10) - (10 - 1) AND (#{currentPage} * 10)

mapper.select: select sb.*, s.* from store_budget sb, store s where sb.store_no=s.store_no

SELECT T.RNUM, T.*, S.store_nm FROM ( SELECT ROW_NUMBER() OVER (ORDER BY store_budget_year, store_budget_date DESC) AS RNUM, NVL((SELECT SUM(store_budget) FROM store_budget h2 WHERE h2.store_budget_year = h.store_budget_year AND h2.store_budget_ty = 2 AND h2.store_no = #{storeNo}), 0) AS useTotal, ( (SELECT SUM(store_budget) FROM store_budget h2 WHERE h2.store_budget_year = h.store_budget_year AND h2.store_budget_ty = 1 AND h2.store_no = #{storeNo}) - NVL((SELECT SUM(store_budget) FROM store_budget h2 WHERE h2.store_budget_year = h.store_budget_year AND h2.store_budget_ty = 2 AND h2.store_no = #{storeNo}), 0)) AS restBG, h.* FROM store_budget h WHERE h.store_no = #{storeNo} AND h.store_budget_ty = 1 ) T JOIN store S ON T.store_no = S.store_no WHERE T.RNUM BETWEEN (#{currentPage} * 10) - (10 - 1) AND (#{currentPage} * 10)
